vectors.name: synthesized_defaults_v5
vectors.why: Every field this version declares, at its protocol default. Synthesized so the message is held to Apache Kafka's bytes at all; hand-written cases carry the interesting shapes.

vectors.name: a_tag_on_a_nested_struct_carries_a_value
vectors.why: `TopicConfigErrorCode` is tag 0 of a topic result, not of the response. It proves a struct nested in an array emits a tagged section of its own.
